comment: The outcome of Playwright's own Firefox (stock.lock) on each page: 'idle' means page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle') arrives. A page enters this list after 20 green runs of stock in a row; if stock deviates, the suite is red as a broken control. newsfront is not listed: stock Firefox stalls on it 1 or 2 times in 10 (a pending list that is empty), so it cannot be a gate until a minimal pattern replaces it.

journey_p4.comment: Profile P4 (tests/fakeweb/profile_p4.py): the steps on which stock Firefox does NOT reach networkidle within the timeout, because the page holds a request open on purpose: 7 and 8 (a fetch held until step 9, on the category page), 12 (a keepalive fetch held until step 13, on the search results). Stock Firefox idles on every other step, and every step is ok.
